SECTION_9.TITLE: 10. Security of your data
SECTION_9.LIST_0: Encryption of communications via the HTTPS protocol (TLS)
SECTION_9.LIST_1: Encryption of sensitive data at rest with AES-256-GCM (authenticated encryption) — account data (national ID, phone, address), tenant data, and payment data
SECTION_9.LIST_2: Password hashing with the bcrypt algorithm
SECTION_9.LIST_3: Encrypted data search via HMAC-SHA256 (for search fields without decryption)
SECTION_9.LIST_4: Token-based authentication sent by email for account confirmation
SECTION_9.LIST_5: Data access restricted to team members who need it
SECTION_9.LIST_6: Data breach notification procedure in accordance with Cameroonian law n°2024/017 and the RGPD (GDPR) (72-hour deadline)
SECTION_9.ACTION_TEXT: Two-factor authentication (2FA): not currently available — planned for a future release.
SECTION_9.BODY_0: Despite the measures in place, no system is infallible. If you suspect your account has been compromised, contact us immediately at support@ndewa-360.com.

SECTION_10.TITLE: 11. Retention periods
TABLE_ROWS: Immediate deletion, except for the exceptions below
10 years from the last transaction (Cameroonian accounting obligations) — automatic deletion
12 rolling months — automatic deletion via MongoDB TTL index
Lifetime of the account, deleted upon closure
SECTION_10.CALLOUT_TEXT: These retention periods are automatically enforced by scheduled server-side processes. Financial data is purged after 10 years, connection logs after 12 months. Accounts inactive for more than one year receive an email warning 30 days before automatic anonymization.

SECTION_11.TITLE: 12. Your rights
SECTION_11.BODY_0: In accordance with Cameroonian law n°2024/017 of December 23, 2024, and the principles of the RGPD (GDPR) for users residing in the European Union, you have the following rights:
SECTION_11.RIGHTS_0_DESC: Obtain confirmation that we process your data and receive a copy. You can export your data from your personal space.
SECTION_11.RIGHTS_1_DESC: Correct inaccurate or incomplete data concerning you, directly from your personal space.
SECTION_11.RIGHTS_2_DESC: Request the deletion of your data in the cases provided by law. You can delete your account from the dangerous section of your profile.
SECTION_11.RIGHTS_3_DESC: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format (JSON). Available via the "Export my data" button in your profile.
SECTION_11.RIGHTS_4_DESC: Object to the processing of your data in certain cases, particularly for direct marketing purposes.
SECTION_11.RIGHTS_5_DESC: Request the temporary suspension of the processing of your data, for example in the event of a dispute over its accuracy.
SECTION_11.BODY_1: You can exercise your rights as follows:
SECTION_11.LIST_0: Access, portability, and rectification: directly from your personal space ("My Data & Cookies" section).
SECTION_11.LIST_1: Account deletion: from the "Danger Zone" section of your profile.
SECTION_11.LIST_2: Restriction and objection: by email to dpo@ndewa-360.com.
SECTION_11.BODY_2: Your request must specify: the right you wish to exercise, the data concerned, and any information allowing us to verify your identity.
SECTION_11.BODY_3: Response time: We commit to responding within a maximum of 48 hours from receipt of your request.
SECTION_11.BODY_4: If you believe that the processing of your data does not comply with applicable regulations, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent authority:
SECTION_11.LIST_3: For users in Cameroon: with the competent Cameroonian authority designated by law n°2024/017 (contact details to be provided once the authority is operational).
SECTION_11.LIST_4: For users in the European Union: with the data protection authority of your country of residence (in France: the CNIL — www.cnil.fr).

SECTION_0.BODY_0: A cookie is a small text file stored on your device (computer, tablet, smartphone) when you visit a website. Cookies allow the site to remember your actions and preferences for a specified duration, so that you do not have to re-enter them each time you visit.
SECTION_0.LIST_0: Session cookies — automatically deleted when you close your browser.
SECTION_0.LIST_1: Persistent cookies — stored on your device for a defined period, even after closing the browser.
SECTION_0.LIST_2: First-party cookies — set directly by Ndewa360.
SECTION_0.LIST_3: Third-party cookies — set by third-party services integrated into the platform.

SECTION_2.CALLOUT_TEXT: If you have 3 occupied units with rents of 50,000 FCFA, 75,000 FCFA, and 100,000 FCFA, your monthly invoice will be: (50,000 × 2%) + (75,000 × 2%) + (100,000 × 2%) = 1,000 + 1,500 + 2,000 = 4,500 FCFA.
SECTION_2.BODY_1: Invoices are generated automatically and available in your personal space. Payment is due upon receipt of the invoice.
SECTION_2.BODY_2: In the event of non-payment, in accordance with GTU section 10, your account may be suspended. Your account will be automatically reactivated upon settlement of outstanding invoices.

SECTION_3.TITLE: 4. Billing errors
SECTION_3.BODY_0: If you notice a billing error (incorrect amount, unit billed while it was vacant, duplicate billing), you have 30 days from the invoice date to contact our support.
SECTION_3.BODY_1: After verification, confirmed errors will result in:
SECTION_3.LIST_0: a full refund of the overcharged amount, as soon as possible;
SECTION_3.LIST_1: or a credit on your account, deducted from the next invoice, according to your preference.

SECTION_4.TITLE: 5. Cancellation and refund
SECTION_4.BODY_0: You may cancel your Premium subscription at any time from your personal space. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period.
SECTION_4.LIST_0: Cancellation during the month: the current month's invoice remains due. No partial refund is issued for the remaining days of the current month.
SECTION_4.LIST_1: Cancellation before billing: if you cancel before the monthly invoice is generated, no amount will be charged for the following month.
SECTION_4.BODY_1: In the event of account deletion (from the "Danger Zone" section of the profile), unpaid invoices remain due. Payments already made are not refunded, except in the case of a confirmed billing error in accordance with section 4.
SECTION_4.CALLOUT_TEXT: Unless there is a billing error on our part, no pro-rata refund is issued for the remaining days in the current billing period upon cancellation.
